svg.title: Visual abstract: Latent factors across omics, species and time
svg.desc: Three factor-model analyses: MOFA+ on 200 chronic lymphocytic leukemia patients across mRNA, DNA methylation, mutations and drug response, where Factor 1 separates IGHV-mutated from unmutated patients; MEFISTO on 83 developmental samples from five species with time warping; and a hand-built Pyro factor model whose reconstruction error bottoms out at the true five factors.
svg.text: VISUAL ABSTRACT · MULTI-OMICS FACTOR ANALYSIS · MOFA+ · MEFISTO · PYRO
Latent factors across omics, species and time
MOFA+ on 200 CLL patients across four omics layers, MEFISTO on five-species development, and a Pyro factor model
Four views share one set of latent factors
response. A factor model asks which
hidden axes are shared across layers
and which belong to one layer only.
each with a likelihood that matches
Python: Scanpy, muon, mofax, MEFISTO via mofapy2, PyTorch and Pyro
MOFA+ finds a Factor 1 that separates IGHV-mutated from unmutated CLL, MEFISTO aligns development
across five species, and a hand-built Pyro factor model recovers the true number of factors.
